description: This PHP source file defines the 'AttendanceConfigurationAPI' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Attendance\Api' namespace. The class provides REST API endpoints to get and update attendance configuration settings, including permissions related to modifying attendance and changing current time, for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses traits and external models for handling business logic and data representation, and includes OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for retrieving and updating attendance configuration settings, including permissions for time change and attendance modifications, within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update attendance configuration settings based on provided boolean parameters, manages database transaction, and returns the updated configuration.
